news.headline: Symbotic Analysts Revise Their Forecasts Following Q4 Earnings
news.summary: Symbotic beat Q4 earnings and sales estimates, guided Q1 sales near forecasts, while shares fell 5.8%; analysts raised and cut price targets.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Maintains Sell on Symbotic, Lowers Price Target to $33
news.summary: Goldman Sachs  analyst Mark Delaney   maintains Symbotic (NASDAQ:SYM) with a Sell and lowers the price target from $42 to $33.

news.headline: Needham Maintains Buy on Symbotic, Raises Price Target to $65
news.summary: Needham  analyst Robert Jamieson   maintains Symbotic (NASDAQ:SYM) with a Buy and raises the price target from $60 to $65.
